pinned_at_build.app_image_final_because: REBUILT 2026-09-01 after session 3 (owner-authorised design correction, host-only). (1) arm_attempt now polls STATUS after the strobe, bounded (P3_SETTLE_POLLS_MAX = 1000000 reads), read-only, until !gate_busy && !scorer_busy && (fault || scorer_done) — the same condition host/l3_runner.py polled at L3 — and only then reads FAULT and the nonce; the strobe is written once and never re-issued. A poll that runs out is the new neutral outcome STOP_SETTLE with the whole poll in the record (polls, polls_max, settled, status_first, status_last); STOP_ARM now means the gate settled and did not consume. (2) The TERM's audit block comes from p3_wire's own tally of the records it serialised (p3_wire_tally), never from scored + refused. The binary is 16384 bytes larger than 10044abe's because .text/.rodata grew by 0x2f0 bytes, .data's end crossed 0x02010000 and the 16 KiB-aligned .mmu_tbl moved to 0x02014000, so objcopy pads one more page: layout, not code. Two from-scratch builds are byte-identical. Neither correction has run on hardware: the early-read explanation is strongly supported by session 3's record and the RTL; standalone success after bounded settling remains untested.

console_uart.source: D1 spec T1 (the console = UART1) + every 17A6 board run's relay; not guessed

bsp_inputs.note: the exact third-party Xilinx embeddedsw files build.sh compiles into the image (sources + header closure, from the pinned toolchain's own gcc -M). These are referenced in place, not vendored; app_image_sha256 is reproducible against this identified input set (checked by sha256) plus the pinned toolchain, not merely against 'this host's embeddedsw tree'. tests/test_bsp_inputs_manifest.py re-hashes them.

pinned_at_build.watchdog_status: NOT USED — session 1 runs watchdog-off (owner's ruling on D-c, 2026-08-31). P3_WDT_LOAD is 0 in the image and unreachable: the firmware gates both the arm and the kick on identity_page flags.bit1, which this session writes as 0.

identity_page_flags.note: the session's identity page MUST NOT declare the watchdog enabled. Flipping bit1 alone is forbidden: the load is 0, i.e. an immediate timeout. Enabling the watchdog is a firmware change (a prescaler write) with its own build, preregistration and ruling.

watchdog_finding.why_it_could_not_be_30_s: the 32-bit A9 private watchdog at PERIPHCLK=333.33 MHz with prescaler 0 tops out at 12.88 s; p3_app.c programs no prescaler and the driver exposes no SetPrescaler. See docs/l5_findings.md §4.
watchdog_finding.peripheral_clock_note: = CPU_6x4x/2; CPU_6x4x assumes the standard 6:2:1 ratio — ARM PLL 1333.33 MHz is board-confirmed, CPU_CLK_CTRL (0xF8000120) was never captured. Pre-board preflight, not a build blocker: nothing in a watchdog-off session depends on it.

if_ever_enabled.requires: a p3_app.c control-register write, a new build, a new prereg and a new ruling

preflight_before_board: md.l 0xF8000120 1 (CPU_CLK_CTRL) once at first power-on, stored with the session evidence; until then CPU_6x4x/PERIPHCLK are assumed, and no timing conversion derived from them may be reported as verified fact
pinned_at_build.note: COMPLETE. toolchain, console_uart, the embeddedsw BSP input set (manifests/l5_bsp_inputs.json) and app_image_sha256 are pinned; the watchdog is deliberately off for session 1 and its load value is therefore not used rather than unset. Host recovery for a watchdog-off session is fixed in docs/l5_prereg.md §4.

SUPERSEDED, not defective, 2026-09-01 (design correction after session 3). It is the image that ran session 3 and produced evidence/l5_17A6_2026-09-01-03/, and it stays identifiable for that reason. Its two defects are in when it reads and what it counts: arm_attempt read the nonce immediately after the strobe, while rtl/p3_arm_gate.v steps the nonce only on sh_done (session 3 saw gate_busy SET and the old nonce), and the TERM's audit.total was scored + refused, so its own STOP_ARM record was not counted and rule (ix) rejected the log.

audit_policy.note: every candidate that staged is audited (including a link-2 refusal, whose claim is about the staged words). A gate refusal staged nothing, so no raw words exist and it is exempt; its corroboration is the notary_log's own refusal under rule (vii). 'Every candidate is audited' was not implementable and is no longer the condition.
